candidates.change_summary: Change the final returned value from true to false so transfer completes but returns a different boolean.
Invert the require that _tos.length > 0 to allow zero-length arrays and thus change return behavior for that input.
Replace the final return true with returning the success flag from the last caddress.call, changing observed return value.

Replace the require that enforces sender equality with a require that enforces the caller is NOT the original address, flipping the access check so different callers can execute and thereby possibly change emitted state via caddress calls.
Change the require that _tos has positive length to require it be empty, allowing only zero-length arrays and preventing the loop from running, altering post-call observable effects.
Remove the scaling by 1e18 when calling the external contract so the transferred value uses the raw v[i], which changes the external call effects.
Replace the call to caddress.call with a checked low-level call that requires success, causing revert on failed external calls and changing observable post-call state when external call fails.
Change require that validates v[i] scaling to a weaker check that allows any v[i] (remove the divisibility check), permitting values that previously reverted and thus changing observable outcomes.
